segments.name: Structured Business
segments.description: Originates and holds bridge, mezzanine and preferred equity loans on multifamily, SFR and commercial real estate for borrowers.
segments.evidence: Through our Structured Business, we focus primarily on the following investment types: Bridge Financing.

segments.name: Agency Business
segments.description: Originates, sells and services multifamily agency loans through Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, Ginnie Mae, FHA and HUD, retaining servicing.
segments.evidence: Through our Agency Business, we focus primarily on the following investment types: GSE and HUD Agency Lending.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest and fees on structured loans, and the Agency Business earns origination and servicing fees from GSE and HUD programs.
revenueModel.evidence: Additional yield enhancements may include origination fees, deferred interest, yield look-backs, and participating interests, which are equity interests in the borrower that share in a percentage of the underlying cash flows of the property.
